description: This file defines the RemindersService class in Swift, which implements functionality to list and add reminders using EventKit. It interacts with the iOS reminders database, handles permissions, and performs operations such as fetching reminders, filtering by status, and creating new reminders with optional due dates and notes.

classes.name: RemindersService
classes.description: A final class implementing the RemindersServicing protocol, responsible for listing and adding reminders, managing permissions, and handling reminder calendar operations.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Asynchronously fetches a list of reminders based on provided parameters, handling permissions, filtering by completion status, and returning a payload list.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Asynchronously adds a new reminder with specified details such as title, notes, due date, and list, handling permissions and validation.
